goal: Add calendar-action affordances inside Orbit AI conversations with safe preview and confirmation boundaries.

success_criteria.description: Orbit AI result cards for follow-up, recommendation, event, and to-do flows can expose an add-to-calendar affordance only when a concrete title, time, person or event link, and reason are available.
The add-to-calendar preview shows exactly what would be added, what data source produced it, and whether the action is local-only or still unconfirmed.
Focused tests assert that unconfirmed previews perform no saved record write, external calendar mutation, notification, message send, or outside network request.
GET /app/agent calendar-action scenarios preserve the original AI answer while showing a clear staged action state and a cancellation path.
The feature documentation defines the future live calendar adapter boundary and the no-side-effect default used by tests.

out_of_scope: Writing to Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, email, notifications, or remote stores by default
